alternatives_rejected.why: Its latency rise (z=21, ~2x per E1) is far smaller than emailservice's (z=900, 45x). Per E2, emailservice's inbound calls, made by its callers such as checkout, slowed from 3.5 to 204ms, so checkout's latency is propagated from emailservice.

E2 shows emailservice's own self-time unchanged (0.19ms, 1.04x), and E1, ranked across all services and metrics, shows no resource metric deviations. The delay sits on the network path, not in compute.

proposed_fix.description: Remove the injected network delay (e.g. tc netem qdisc or chaos rule) on emailservice's pod interface, or restart/reschedule the emailservice pod. Then confirm emailservice p90 latency and checkout latency return to baseline.
